# n6 - The projection command and the doctor drift finding

`scripts/index-projection <store>` prints the drift and exits non-zero when there is any;
`--write` renders INDEX.md's four status sections from the projection through `AtomicWrite`. The
drift is also reported as a doctor finding, emitted from the existing `check_done_signals` in
`scripts/doctor.rb` and scoped to what `savepoint_operational` does not already cover. Folded at
review (A6, D14): no new excludable rule key is registered, and `scripts/lib/doctor_core.rb`, the
installation doctor, is not touched at all.

## n6 failure-mode matrix
| Row | Operation | Failure mode | Test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 6.1 | Compare without writing by default | Running the command to look at the drift rewrites INDEX.md, and an inspection becomes an edit of the store's spine | `index_projection_cli_test#test_default_run_changes_no_bytes` |
| 6.2 | Write INDEX.md only under `--write` | The flag is ignored and the guard D7 puts on the store's spine is decorative | `index_projection_cli_test#test_write_flag_is_required_before_any_byte_changes` |
| 6.3 | Write through `AtomicWrite` | A crash mid-write leaves INDEX.md truncated, which loses the index of the entire store | `index_projection_cli_test#test_write_goes_through_atomic_write` |
| 6.4 | Carry an entry's existing text into the rewritten section | The rewrite regenerates entry lines from ids and drops the notes and titles INDEX carries, so a status fix costs the store its descriptions | `index_projection_cli_test#test_rewrite_preserves_each_entry_line_text` |
| 6.5 | Exit non-zero when drift exists | Every caller and hook reads exit 0 and no automation can gate on a drifting store | `index_projection_cli_test#test_exit_is_1_when_drift_exists_and_0_when_clean` |
| 6.6 | Refuse a path that is not a store | The command prints a backtrace on a typo instead of a reason | `index_projection_cli_test#test_non_store_path_exits_with_a_named_reason` |
| 6.7 | Report only the drift `savepoint_operational` does not already cover | Folded at review (A6): the existing rule already reports the missing and silent ledgers, so an unscoped finding repeats roughly 103 of them on the plastic store and the new signal is lost in its own noise | `doctor_index_drift_test#test_drift_finding_excludes_what_savepoint_operational_reports` |
| 6.8 | Emit the finding from `check_done_signals` in `scripts/doctor.rb` | Folded at review (A6): `doctor_core.rb` is the installation doctor and has no store-scoped check, so a finding placed there never runs against a store at all | `doctor_index_drift_test#test_finding_is_emitted_from_check_done_signals` |
| 6.9 | Leave `RuleCatalog::EXCLUDABLE_CHECKS` unchanged | Folded at review (A6): `rule_catalog_test` pins the two keys verbatim, so registering a third fails a shipped test, and the sibling test then demands the new key be a real `check_done_signals` name | `doctor_index_drift_test#test_rule_catalog_excludable_checks_is_unchanged` |
| 6.10 | Pass the doctor rule when INDEX and the ledgers agree | The finding fires on every healthy store and is trained out of the owner's attention | `doctor_index_drift_test#test_finding_is_silent_when_index_and_ledgers_agree` |
| 6.11 | Survive a store with no intents and no ledgers | The doctor run crashes on a freshly provisioned project store | `doctor_index_drift_test#test_empty_store_does_not_crash` |
| 6.12 | Leave every existing doctor finding unchanged on a clean store | The new finding reorders or renumbers existing findings and every doctor test and habit breaks at once | `doctor_index_drift_test#test_existing_doctor_findings_are_unchanged_on_a_clean_store` |
| 6.13 | Carry `## Clusters` and `## Relocated` through the write byte-identical | Folded at review (B5, D17): the plastic store's INDEX has six sections, and `Relocated` alone starts at line 589. A writer that rebuilds only the four status sections and reassembles the file can silently drop the other two | `index_projection_cli_test#test_clusters_and_relocated_sections_are_byte_identical_after_write` |
| 6.14 | Refuse to demote an entry whose ledger is silent, even under `--write` | Folded at review (A4): this is the same rule as row 5.13, asserted at the writer rather than the model, because the model being right does not stop a writer from being wrong | `index_projection_cli_test#test_write_never_demotes_an_entry_whose_ledger_is_silent` |
| 6.15 | Register `scripts/index-projection` and its lib in `CORE_FILES` | Folded at review (B1): the packaging scan covers every file under `scripts/`, so an unregistered command turns the suite red and would raise `LoadError` on an installed Plastic | `index_projection_cli_test#test_command_and_lib_are_registered_in_core_files` |
